videos.headline: The microwave Short reached 45 views and lost almost everyone after the hook: only 4.2% held after it.

why.text: 45 views, against 118 and 255 for the channel's two later Shorts.
26.8% viewed of 60 s; 4.2% held after the hook, on 37 Analytics views.
The steepest fall was 34.8 points at 7.5 s (the line isn't known: the stats job looked for this channel's timeline in the wrong folder, fixed tonight).
97.3% of views came from the Shorts feed, all from the US.

videos.next: Reach the surprising invention moment before 7 s and cut the Short well under 60 s: by 7.5 s only 43.5% of the starting viewers were left.
